DIWAKAR KURMANA

Senior Security Engineer | Cloud, WAF & Platform Security Bangalore, India | +91-9494484157 | diwakar.k0974@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/diwakarkurmana

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Security Engineer with 8+ years of experience (2018–2026) securing high-scale, internet-facing platforms across AWS and Azure. Deep expertise in Cloud Security, WAF, network security automation, and AI-driven threat detection. Proven track record designing and operationalizing security controls at scale — reducing incident response time, improving security visibility, and automating decision pipelines for large enterprises. Experienced in cross-functional collaboration bridging infrastructure, compliance, and development teams to deliver resilient, Zero Trust-aligned architectures.

CORE SKILLS

Security Platforms & Tools: FortiGate, Palo Alto (PAN-OS), Cisco ASA, Azure WAF, FortiWeb, FortiDDoS, FortiSIEM, FortiAnalyzer, SolarWinds, Syslog, Grafana, FortiManager, Palo Alto Panorama, FortiClient, Cisco ISE (NAC), zTNA, CyberArk EPM, Forcepoint DLP, FortiSandbox, IPS/IDS Automation & Tooling: Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, Postman, API-driven security workflows, verdict-based controls, CrushFTP integrations, MCP, OAuth 2.0, Claude AI, Azure Key Vault, Entra ID, APIM, JWT/JWKS, SSE

Cloud & Network Security: AWS (VPCs, Subnets, Routing, Security Groups), Azure (vWAN, NVAs, VNet Peering, Private Endpoints, Storage Accounts), IBM Cloud, Network Segmentation & Labeling, Forti SD-WAN, ADVPN, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, STP/RSTP, HSRP/VRRP, Cisco Meraki, Aruba Security Domains: WAF, SSL/TLS deep inspection, outbound inspection, OWASP Top 10 mitigation, malware analysis, threat detection, DLP, SIEM analytics, incident response, Zero Trust, IAM, compliance dashboards

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Network and Security Engineer

Jun 2023 – Present

Sapiens International Corporation, India • Led cloud, network, and platform security initiatives for business-critical applications across AWS, Azure, and IBM Cloud — owning

end-to-end security architecture for production environments

Designed and operated WAF protections (Azure WAF, FortiWeb) for internet-facing applications, mitigating OWASP Top 10 threats and custom attack vectors

Built security automation pipelines using FortiSandbox APIs — automated malware scanning, verdicting, and quarantine with verdict-based allow/block controls

Integrated sandbox verdicts with CrushFTP, scanning and processing thousands of files per day before release into production storage • Implemented SSL/TLS deep inspection, outbound inspection profiles, IPS/IDS policies, and application control across enterprise perimeter • Designed and managed Forti SD-WAN, ADVPN, Azure vWAN, NVAs, and multi-region connectivity with production SLAs and failover • Delivered network segmentation, micro-segmentation, and labeling projects fully aligned with Zero Trust principles • Created security dashboards and analytics using FortiAnalyzer, FortiSIEM, SolarWinds, and Grafana — improving visibility and MTTR Key Impact: >90% reduction in malware exposure | ~60% improvement in MTTR | Automated security decisions for thousands of files/day

Integrated sandbox verdicts with CrushFTP, scanning and processing thousands of files per day before release into production storage • Implemented SSL/TLS deep inspection, outbound inspection profiles, IPS/IDS policies, and application control across enterprise perimeter • Designed and managed Forti SD-WAN, ADVPN, Azure vWAN, NVAs, and multi-region connectivity with production SLAs and failover • Delivered network segmentation, micro-segmentation, and labeling projects fully aligned with Zero Trust principles • Created security dashboards and analytics using FortiAnalyzer, FortiSIEM, SolarWinds, and Grafana — improving visibility and MTTR Key Impact: >90% reduction in malware exposure | ~60% improvement in MTTR | Automated security decisions for thousands of Sep 2022 – Jun 2023

Sapiens International Corporation, India • Managed FortiGate and Palo Alto firewalls — policy design, NAT, IPS/IDS, SSL inspection, and change management across enterprise

environments

Administered Cisco switches, Meraki, and Aruba network infrastructure; handled VLANs, spanning tree, and uplink management • Supported proxy handling, Forcepoint DLP implementation, and CyberArk EPM privileged access management • Implemented Cisco ISE NAC, FortiClient endpoint compliance, and zTNA access controls for remote users • Supported AWS VPCs, Azure VNets, peering configurations, and storage account security hardening • Performed incident response, firewall change management, root cause analysis, and operational troubleshooting Spiderweb Infotech Private Limited, India • Delivered L2/L3 network and firewall support using Cisco, Palo Alto, and F5 technologies for enterprise clients • Implemented and maintained VLANs, STP/RSTP, HSRP/VRRP, BGP, NAT, and VPN tunnels across multi-site environments • Assisted in network capacity planning, infrastructure upgrades, and documentation for client networks

Jul 2018 – Aug 2022

Network Engineer

KEY PROJECTS • Automated Malware Detection & Quarantine Platform: Designed API-driven malware detection using FortiSandbox with automated

allow/block/quarantine, real-time alerts, compliance dashboards, and CrushFTP file pipeline integration

Multi-Cloud Secure SD-WAN Platform: Architected hub-and-spoke SD-WAN across AWS & Azure using Forti ADVPN with production SLAs, automatic failover, and centralized FortiManager policy management

MCP / OAuth / Claude AI Integrations: Designed secure integration workflows with MCP server authentication, Microsoft Entra ID + APIM dual-auth, OAuth 2.0 token handling, and Claude AI enterprise use cases including Bitbucket MCP with per-user identity preservation

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

B.Tech – Electronics & Communication Engineering NIT Calicut | 2017

Certification Trainings: FortiGate NSE 4 | CCNA | Palo Alto PCNSA | Azure Networking |

AWS Networking | Claude AI
